verdict.rationale: Vestd markets digital cap table management as "one source of truth, reconciled," with share pools issued per share class and Companies House updated automatically. It also documents share certificates, EMI/CSOP/unapproved option grants and exercises, and data rooms where cap tables can be shared with chosen parties such as investors. missing for 10: any evidence of SAFE (or convertible instrument) tracking, detailed documentation of certificate management beyond a page title, explicit auditor-facing features, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing.
